description: Initial discovery centered on COVID demonstrations and curfew unrest; weekly, sector and regional searches for other policy protests remain incomplete.
required_followup: Search Dutch and English news, local/regional outlets, labor, education, health, environment and official sources for each week of January.

description: The Oude Markt Enschede report says “dozens,” which does not resolve the >=50 threshold.
required_followup: Find local reporting, independent estimates or official attendance data for the gathering.

description: The Tilburg lead has a protest-like announcement but no specific state-policy demand; crowd size is also unquantified.
required_followup: Find local reporting or organizer/official statements establishing whether a public protest occurred, what it demanded and whether 50 or more attended.

description: The Venlo report documents a large group and stone throwing but no policy demand or protest framing; count is unknown.
required_followup: Review local police and media reports to distinguish a curfew protest from criminal street disorder and establish attendance.

description: The Hague Schilderswijk update mentions an online call to demonstrate, a crowd and a street fire, but gives no demand or size and does not establish that the crowd was the announced demonstrators.
required_followup: Check local reporting for an actual assembly, state demand, crowd estimate and any relation to separate arson/disorder.

description: Physical departure/end remains unknown for Amsterdam gatherings and some other leads; a cleared square, last report or calm at a location is not automatically the end of all participants.
required_followup: Follow reports beyond the last warning/dispersal and determine whether participants left, dispersed or moved elsewhere.

description: January 17 and January 24 Museumplein assemblies are separate dates and currently separate candidates; campaign-level linkage and cross-city event boundaries need review.
required_followup: Compare organizers, demands, mobilization and physical continuity; apply the missing authors’ Coding Procedure before any merge or split approval.

description: Latest official baseline, full original coverage window/schema/license and authors’ additional Coding Procedure remain unresolved at project level.
required_followup: Coordinator continues baseline retrieval and compatibility review; this unit remains pending official baseline.

description: Fourteen Dutch/English open-web searches, including weekly, sector, regional, event-specific and before/after-month follow-ups, do not reproduce the specified LexisNexis source procedure and do not establish exhaustive coverage.
required_followup: If the next research pass continues, add systematic local/regional and official searching by week and sector, record empty outcomes and access failures, and compare coverage to the required LexisNexis method.

description: Stein crowd estimates conflict: NRC says about 100 youths protesting the curfew, while NOS says dozens; threshold is unresolved.
required_followup: Find municipal or police primary records establishing the number present.

description: Urk reporting says dozens of youths and separately about 100 cars; the cars are not attendees and the youth count does not resolve 50.
required_followup: Find local attendance evidence and distinguish protesters from arsonists or rioters.

description: Rotterdam Jan 23 estimates vary from about 100 at the protest to around 50 remaining after curfew; the time-specific counts may not establish a firm minimum.
required_followup: Review local reporting and the event timeline to confirm threshold.

description: Den Helder and Amersfoort Jan 23 demonstrations against curfew are reported without crowd numbers.
required_followup: Search regional outlets and official records for attendance and response.

description: The 10 January Amsterdam anti-fascism demonstration had about 350 attendees, but the opened contemporary report does not establish a specific demand addressed to the Dutch state.
required_followup: Check an organizer statement or other contemporary coverage for a domestic state-demand; retain pending_evidence absent that connection.

description: The 31 January Amsterdam square was cleared, but NOS says demonstrators remained in surrounding streets; the physical end of the wider gathering is unresolved.
required_followup: Search same-day local follow-up for final departure from surrounding streets.

description: Thirty arrests were reported on Valeriusplein near the 31 January Amsterdam gathering, but the opened NOS source does not establish that detainees were assembly participants.
required_followup: Check local police or city reporting for participant/phase attribution before coding arrests as an event response.

description: RTV Apeldoorn reported that the previously announced 31 January event organizer canceled, while NOS reported about 400 people at Zwitsalterrein that day.
required_followup: Check contemporary local reporting to determine whether the actual gathering had a different organizer or proceeded despite the cancellation.

description: Breda Tuinzigt on 24 January: the opened retrospective report estimates about 70 people gathered after a curfew-opposition call, while an official court search excerpt says 40–50 were in the area around 20:20. The event-level threshold is supported by the former estimate, but time-specific count and the relationship between the gathering and later disorder remain uncertain.
required_followup: If the official judgment body becomes accessible, compare the exact time and group against the retrospective report; keep later criminal acts and the gathering’s physical end separately sourced.

description: A retrospective report says about 50 people gathered at Helmond De Braak on 24 January amid signals about continuing riots and that police dispersed them. The group’s own demand against state policy is unclear, and the approximate crowd estimate is at the threshold. This is distinct from the announced afternoon stadium demonstration where only a handful attended.
required_followup: Check whether the evening group articulated a state-directed demand and whether the approximate estimate establishes 50 attendees; do not merge with the afternoon announcement or label all attendees as rioters.
